verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own API, but the documented scope is narrow: adding candidates, listing hires, and hosting a careers page. The UI covers far more, including interview scheduling, outreach campaigns, CRM, AI scoring, notes and @mentions, referrals, offers and bulk actions, so API parity with the UI is not shown. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at standard paths. Missing for 10: API coverage of scheduling, feedback, outreach/CRM, scoring, notes, referrals, offers and bulk actions; a published API reference or OpenAPI spec; independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Add candidates, list hires, and host a custom careers page with the Dover API.
